_comment: Acceptance-test registry for the EC-16..EC-26 enforcement scaffolding. Parsed by scripts/ci/reading_note_map_check.py: every AT-nn named in docs/directives/INDEX.md must be a key here (missing checks fail closed). 'node' entries are pytest node IDs on the exact candidate (EC-20 executes them via scripts/ci/verify_claimed_shas.py --run-tests).

AT-01.name: EC-16/EC-19 claimed-SHA extraction, offline verification, directive fields

AT-03.name: EC-25 deploy-trigger lint (push/workflow_run flagged; PR-trigger and test jobs accepted)

AT-04.name: EC-22 status vocabulary (RUN_PASS run id, percentage, clean scan, pre-existing)

AT-05.name: EC-18 evidence sequence (monotonic timestamps, drift, RECONSTRUCTED)

AT-06.name: EC-26 reading-note mapping (blob citations, rule mappings)

AT-07.name: PR template carries the required machine-readable fields

AT-08.name: EC-26 fail-closed negatives: missing note, missing blob, unmapped rule, empty inventory, duplicate IDs, malformed row, unknown status, missing enforcement/test

AT-09.name: EC-20 acceptance tests EXECUTED on the candidate: missing test fails, failing test fails, pass produces evidence record (command argv, SHA, counts, exit)

AT-10.name: EC-21 remote base verification, stack-parent validation, shallow-history fail-closed, malformed SHA

AT-11.name: EC-22 manifest-backed statuses: unknown token, fabricated run ID, wrong-SHA run, non-success run, unsupported percentage, uncited clean scan, unsupported pre-existing

AT-12.name: EC-16 strict SHA lists (any malformed entry rejects the whole list) + fail-closed remote errors + exact returned-SHA match

AT-13.name: EC-18/EC-24 append-only parent-prefix check + push-log two-phase truthfulness (P-011 confirmation carries the real full SHA)

AT-14.name: EC-25 remediation: push-triggered deploy fixture flagged; dispatch-only fixture accepted; gate trigger fix contains no 'ain]' defect

AT-15.name: EC-23 workflow structure: action pinned to a verified 40-hex commit, least-privilege permissions, full-history + all-refs steps, seeded-secret detection test

AT-16.name: Inventory consistency: workflow/checker/test counts in README, receipt, index agree with the actual tree

AT-18.name: EC-20 per-file scoped collection (Round-19): an unrelated legacy module that sys.exit()s at import time cannot abort collection of the named acceptance tests; naming a test inside an unimportable module or a missing file still fails closed

AT-17.name: EC-26 ACTIVE-liveness (Round-19): an ACTIVE rule citing workflow:proposals/ci/... (inert draft), an @ref-pinned workflow, or a live-path file absent from the tree FAILS; citing the live unpinned .github/workflows file with the named job PASSES; PROPOSED rules may still cite inert drafts

AT-20.name: EC-18/EC-24 push-log schema hardening (Round-19): duplicate ENTRY-IDs, CONFIRM entries missing branch/remote_sha/credential/evidence, INTENT entries missing branch/credential, ENTRY-IDs outside the P- grammar, and CONFIRMs with nothing to confirm all FAIL; an unpaired INTENT is reported PENDING without implying the two-phase protocol is complete; the real mainline log passes

AT-19.name: EC-22 Status-summary grammar (Round-19): PR-body Status-summary lines carry the same vocabulary as STATUS: lines -- off-vocabulary tokens (e.g. ACTIVATION_PENDING) fail, NOT_RUN/PUSHED/MERGED pass, RUN_PASS inside Status-summary is validated against the runs manifest

AT-21.name: EC-23 fingerprint allowlist (exact documented fp passes; new docs//evidence/ finding fails; contradiction fails; baseline integrity; H-1 separate under A-02; empty report passes; fail-closed missing report)

AT-22.name: EC-23 scan controls (genuine detection + fired rule + redaction verified; scanner exit 0/1, missing/malformed report, unredacted key, unexpected findings all fail; clean-repository negative control passes)

AT-23.name: EC-26 trigger liveness (valid push/PR passes; manual-only, branch-excluded, branches-ignore, missing annotation, unknown event token, absent on: block all fail; PROPOSED drafts allowed)

AT-24.name: EC-24 remote-ref verification (CURRENT/HISTORICAL classification; stale-but-undeclared tip fails; PENDING declared tip passes; RECONCILE records; mismatched branch, fabricated evidence, unpaired confirm, unreachable remote, contradicting run evidence all fail)

AT-25.name: EC-23 secret-control disclosure: Secret/Match values never printed on any path; fail-closed capture logs and report validation

AT-26.name: EC-24 identifier pairing + terminal-intent exact-candidate binding + pre-push-tip validation + multiple-intent rejection

AT-27.name: EC-24 historical proof: ancestry or reviewed evidence-back; run verification fail-closed; failed runs disclosed, never proof

AT-28.name: EC-24 protected-main merge transition: verified merge-intent, raced/unrelated/unapproved merges fail

AT-29.name: EC-26 path-filter coverage (~governs=) and invalid filter types fail closed

AT-30.name: EC-23 report-derived field leakage: RuleID/File/StartLine/unexpected fields/non-object rows/malformed reports never reach stdout/stderr on any path; type validation fails closed

AT-31.name: EC-24 independent push provenance + pre-push-state binding: commit existence is not push evidence; push-event runs (event+head_branch), PushEvents, adjudicated citations, push-not-proven reclassification; PushEvent before/after vs the declared tip (false ABSENT, prior unlogged updates, races)

AT-32.name: EC-24 intent-reconciliation invariants: preceding eligible targets, branch scope (push-intent branch / merge-intent source_branch), one void per target, no voiding consumed intents, global unmatched-intent invariant

AT-33.name: EC-24 merge-transition proof + pre-merge gate: merge_commit_sha, source head.ref, merged_at, fresh non-author approval on the exact head (commit_id, pre-merge timing, latest state per reviewer), merge PushEvent before, sequential second merge, DEFERRED supersession, pre-merge PR/head/review verification

AT-34.name: EC-26 conservative glob coverage + ordered filter semantics: witness-based coverage (docs/** vs docs/X), ordered negative patterns in both orders, branches ['**','!main'], empty filter lists, malformed event configuration types
